title: Belgian Chamber of Representatives Open Data: questions and speeches
description:
Structured data compiled from official documents of the Belgian Chamber of Representatives (dekamer.be): questions and speech transcripts from plenary meetings and committee meetings, in Parquet format. Content is in Dutch and French.

Independent project, not affiliated with the Chamber. The CC BY 4.0 license covers the compilation (structure, cleaning, linking); the underlying texts come from official Chamber documents, see NOTICE.md in the repository.
